note: Pinned synthesis cases for bidirectional contradiction accounting. CLAIM-REGISTRY.json, command-center/synthesis/, and a live B12 synthesis corpus are absent on this worktree. These cases are the measurable input set: each row pairs raw claims plus recorded contradiction edges with a synthesis text. Live registry/synthesis paths, if they appear, are inventoried at runtime and not silently substituted.

claims.text: Council quorum should be 5-of-7 seated jurors.
Council quorum should be 3-of-7 seated jurors.

syntheses.synthesis_text: The panel split: quorum 5-of-7 versus 3-of-7 remain in disagreement. No resolution is recorded. Dissent on quorum size is represented in this synthesis.

claims.text: Hash worktree bytes after CRLF conversion (crlf-hash).
Hash the git blob as stored (blob-hash).

syntheses.synthesis_text: crlf-hash versus blob-hash was a contradiction. We adopt blob-hash because git cat-file returns repository bytes, not worktree conversion, and the CRLF trap is a known false mismatch.

claims.text: Keep the minority report in the published packet (minority-report-keep).
Omit the minority report from the published packet (minority-report-drop).

syntheses.synthesis_text: The council converged on publishing the majority packet. minority-report-keep is the way forward. The published packet is complete.

claims.text: Escalate every high-tier finding to the owner before merge (escalate-high).
Never escalate; the chair may absorb high-tier findings (absorb-high).

syntheses.synthesis_text: All participants agree. Consensus is unanimous. There is no remaining disagreement. Full convergence was reached on the merge gate.

claims.text: Hash the git blob as stored (blob-hash-only).

syntheses.synthesis_text: The inputs agree: blob-hash-only is the method. Consensus is unanimous. There is no remaining disagreement.

claims.text: Close the dissent channel after round 1 (channel-closed).

syntheses.synthesis_text: Everyone agreed that channel-open and channel-closed are both true. All participants agree. Consensus is unanimous.
